description.value: The Valemount & Area Museum is a community heritage museum on Main Street in Valemount, a small mountain town at the junction of the Rockies, Cariboos, and Monashees. It documents the history of the Valemount region and its people, offering touring cyclists a cultural stop in one of BC's most scenic interior corridors. Valemount is a natural waypoint on routes between Jasper and the rest of BC's interior.
